description: After STARTTLS (stoa-ovjps.1), run_session in session.rs takes 14 positional parameters. This is the clippy::too_many_arguments case that was suppressed with #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)] (commit 360fc53). Callers in tests pass None for 6 consecutive optional fields, which makes the call sites unreadable and fragile (wrong positional argument). A SessionConfig or RunSessionArgs struct would make additions safe and call sites self-documenting.
title: smtp: run_session signature now 14 params — should take a config struct
